paragraphs: ContentActive sells ePollBooks, voter check-in technology built around election security, integrity, and efficiency. The company says the product was designed by the team that worked with one of the largest counties in the largest election in US history. Poll workers use an iPad app, while administrators watch a portal that shows check-ins and other live voter events.

Elections can be run in precinct mode or in vote center mode. Registration data syncs quickly enough that officials can add or correct a registration while the voter is still waiting at the polls. Check-in continues offline when a location loses its connection, with notifications about connectivity. Each connection is individually authenticated and encrypted with TLS. The software also integrates with Hart and ESS voting systems.

Election offices also get a time and attendance tracker that records pollworker registration and in and out times on the iPad. A voter outreach alerts SMS platform is included for messaging voters. The site lists a Houston, Texas address and phone number. ePollBooks is presented as a ContentActive solution. The site also publishes short notes on Texas election bills.

quote.text: Voter check-in technology built for election security, integrity and efficiency
